strings.1. Checks if the Miniserver already has:
1. Checks if the Miniserver already has a newer version and safeguards against accidental overwrite.
2. Automatically saves a local safety backup of the running Miniserver program to ~/.config/loxone-portable/backups/.
3. Compresses the active project into .LoxCC and uploads sps_new.zip to /prog/.
